reviews.classification: full actual maker catalogue review; source-specific manufacture and retained original blueprint proposal distinguished
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full165-line maker catalogue actually read, recovering the truncated W03/W04 portion before credit. WQ1–WQ14, W01–W19, WF19–WF24, B01–B17, BI1–BI4, E01–E36 and F1–F3/Q1–Q3 retain exact source confidence and proposal status. Its25 folders/17 full-book folders are historical inventory with non-world and duplicate-title routes, not25 playable worlds or17 fully read editions. The first eleven MEMORY rows and inherited SHOWN corrections are content findings, not current external source revalidation.

F2: Preserve the corrected mechanism distinctions: optional item-specific attunement under a selected D&D profile; compatible Elden armaments and distinct upgrade paths; Fallout4 frame/armor/mod/fuel; exceptional Fate projection versus design inspection; manufactured Asauchi versus personal release; FMA continuity and energy conflict; MoL spell/geometry/frame/battery and corrected manifest-specific paragraph locators; weaving versus mundane forging and uncertain original anchor composition. Names, old items, printed symbols and Runehammer/Runestone labels do not establish a universal rune compiler, automatic age power gain or manufacturing recipe.

F3: Legendary Mechanic's cited direct ch5 check concerns combining knowledge/talents into a blueprint, not merging two finished blueprint files. The canonical root's earlier Corrections section already distinguishes this from its original fusion idea. Its imported MKR-OM15 and RC8 shorthand must keep that qualification; the creative finished-design combination remains a proposal rather than discarded history or verified franchise law. A known formula/design is not automatically material, faculty, XP stock, workshop access or executable skill.

F4: Maker roles beside a protagonist are useful on their own. An ordinary carrier/frame/tailor/repair/commission service need not inherit the protagonist's exceptional faculty or await a full profession simulator. Do not mandate a new protagonist bottleneck, universal paid operation or escalating magical/soul craft to justify lived-world work. Actual source can permit effective unusual methods and strong starts under AD38; no automatic equalizing penalty, novice opening or technical category veto follows. A queue is an adaptation choice, not proof of unattended source manufacture. Existing source/actor/body/stock/custody/clock/domain seams and AD51 first useful consumer apply.

F5: Preserve grants versus training, available master versus deceased historical maker, service offer versus completed creation, acquired magical object versus making it, source formula versus memory/stock and recipient/source identity. Shadow Slave3000-source cutoff does not qualify later3024 claims merely cited as a web lead. Sequel/era, novel/adaptation, edition/profile and separate volume outcomes stay bounded. The old source-path relocations, successful hashes and failed web routes describe October14 reading only; this pass opens no book, PDF, private file or external page. Unknown recipes and ambiguous material/energy claims remain named questions rather than new blockers to unrelated work.

F6: Current Klein/HP build direction supersedes dated suggestions about ordinary source roles; paused source-game queues stay paused. Source-corrected WQ14 inventions remain palettes, with any actual seeded secret in a sealed owner and no new truth exposed. Q1/Q2 require exact source only for a selected consequential manufacture route. Q3's useful consumer need not be paid where the actual means is free. AD35/AD36/AD42/AD43 scope selected implementation proof; no runtime, browser, save migration, source acquisition, worker, native UI, commit or push follows from completing this documentation review.
reviews.evidence: All165 current lines read; truncated W03/W04 recovered. Canonical root Corrections section read and imported MKR-OM15/RC8/WQ rows located for exact source distinction. Underlying books/pages not reread.
reviews.reopen: Only selected craft/recipe/source changes require exact qualification and native proof; continue remaining intake.

In the imported alias table, MKR-OM15 and RC8 finished-design combination remain useful original proposals; the cited Legendary Mechanic source instead combines knowledge/talents into a blueprint. Do not treat those retained donor labels as verified franchise manufacture or delete the creative idea. WQ MEMORY/inherited-source rows keep their later W1 evidence corrections: local attunement/armament/profile rules, manufactured blank versus soul release, formula versus supplied spell, continuity/energy conflicts and weaving-anchor uncertainty. This is documentation reconciliation under AD32, not a new crafting implementation or source reread.
